migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: Updated the public source note. Scoring rules and pack fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Adds per-transition, voice stress and timed caption receipts with device and mix budgets. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles no-music, no-spoken-lines, no-spatial-audio. 1.2.0 to 1.3.0: Evidence pack names made genre-neutral (maxFirstTapHandlerMs to maxFirstInputHandlerMs; firstTapHandlerMs to firstInputHandlerMs; announcerLines to spokenLines; leakedNodesAfter10Matches to leakedNodesAfterRepeatedSessions; autoplayBlockedHandled to startBlockedHandled). Scoring, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged; rename these fields in packs made for 1.2.0.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks.
source: Audio evidence includes asset and startup costs, mix measurements, voice usage and playback lifecycle.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.
